categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in photovoltaic (PV) components manufacturing, PV system products, large-scale energy storage systems, and PV power station engineering construction. It focuses on crystalline silicon PV modules, large and residential energy storage products, PV system business including inverters and PCS products, and EPC services for PV power stations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PV technologies including N-type TOPCon, HJT heterojunction, PERC, large-size silicon wafers (182mm and 210mm), bifacial double-glass modules, half-cut cells, multi-busbar (MBB) technology, and zero busbar (0BB) technology. It integrates automated, intelligent, and digital manufacturing processes with MES systems for production control and product lifecycle management. In energy storage, it develops lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery systems with advanced liquid cooling, battery management systems (BMS), and safety features compliant with international standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global customers across more than 160 countries, including key markets in China, the Americas, Europe, Japan, Australia, and emerging markets such as Africa and Latin America. Customers include utility-scale PV power plants, commercial and industrial users, residential users, and EPC clients for PV power station construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases in China (multiple locations), Thailand, the United States (Texas), and sales offices in over 20 countries including Germany, Japan, India, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia. Overseas sales account for over 70% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream silicon wafer production, midstream solar cell and module manufacturing, and downstream system integration and EPC services. It also develops and manufactures energy storage systems, positioning itself as a full-chain provider in the solar and energy storage industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding N-type TOPCon production capacity, advancing HJT and 0BB technologies, developing large-size silicon wafers, and innovating in BIPV (building-integrated photovoltaics) systems. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-efficiency solar cells, advanced materials like ultra-fine welding ribbons and encapsulation films, and intelligent energy storage management systems integrating AI and big data analytics. It also emphasizes digitalization and automation in manufacturing and supply chain management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of photovoltaic modules, PV system products, and energy storage systems. Additional income comes from EPC contracts for PV power station construction and related services. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a top-five global PV module supplier with a leading position in high-efficiency N-type TOPCon and HJT technologies. It competes with other major international PV manufacturers and energy storage system integrators. Its strong global presence, advanced technology portfolio, and integrated supply chain provide competitive advantages in both mature and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 51.31 billion, a 7.94% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.9 billion, up 34.61%. Total assets grew 36.18% to RMB 65.78 billion, and net assets increased 83.64% to RMB 21.42 billion. The company’s R&D investment rose by 50.81%, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with expanding production capacity and global market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and cost-effective PV modules and energy storage solutions. Its unique value lies in its vertically integrated manufacturing, global production and sales network, advanced N-type TOPCon and HJT technologies, and comprehensive energy storage systems with superior safety and efficiency. It also offers differentiated BIPV products and intelligent energy management solutions, supporting customers in reducing carbon footprints and achieving energy cost savings.
